summary: The audit checks the 135 graduate units, research included, the Health Policy Foundations courses, six quarters of HRP 200, HRP 800 and MED 255, and the courses of the track you pick (Health Economics, Decision Science or Evaluative Methods), with every course at B- or better and letter grades where the Bulletin asks for them. Checked by hand: track electives and clusters chosen with your advisor, the practice-of-research seminars, the 3.0 GPA, yearly IDP and progress meetings, responsible conduct of research, the first-year proposal and second-year paper, the written qualifying exams, candidacy, the oral exam, the dissertation and the final presentation. Transfer credit is not accepted.
